blocks.text: Los Angeles-based Filipina artist and songwriter Kiana V returns with her new album, ‘I KNOW BETTER’, a reflection on the messiness of knowing what you should do but choosing differently anyway. Fans can listen to the album HERE. A nine-track project blending R&B, soul, and pop, ‘I KNOW BETTER’ explores the ups and downs of modern love – giving too much too soon, the unexpected return of someone from your past, the difference between words and actions, and finally seeing a situation for what it is.
